verdict.rationale: Raygun documents token-authenticated, non-interactive APIs that fit CI pipelines: a Deployments API, uploading dSYMs and ProGuard mapping files, and uploading source maps via API. Together these support automated deployment tracking from build pipelines. However, the evidence never describes a CLI, a headless run mode, or any CI-specific integration or guide, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented CLI or headless mode, CI/CD integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or other pipeline steps), a published API spec, and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files, Uploading JavaScript files directly to Raygun
manually upload source maps either through our website using the `JS source map center` or via our API
Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
